title: Juicy Crispy Croatian Oxtail Stew
description: A cultured Croatian dish featuring oxtail, this stew is both crispy and diabetic friendly, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
Add the oxtail pieces and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the oxtail from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine and beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the oxtail to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly.
Strain the stew through a fine mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Skim off any excess fat that rises to the surface.
To make the stew crispy, increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the stew in a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
To shock the stew in an ice bath, fill a large bowl with ice and water, then carefully place the baking dish in the ice bath to stop the cooking process.
